description: This file contains the implementation of Memory Management Unit (MMU) functions for ARM64 architecture in Zephyr OS, including page table management, memory mapping, domain initialization, and TLB invalidation.

methods.name: new_table
methods.description: Allocates a new page table from the pre-allocated tables, returning a pointer to it or NULL if none are available.

methods.name: table_index
methods.description: Calculates the index of a table based on the pointer to a page table entry.

methods.name: free_table
methods.description: Marks a page table as free for reuse.

methods.name: table_usage
methods.description: Adjusts the usage count of a page table.

methods.name: is_table_unused
methods.description: Checks if a table is unused based on its usage count.

methods.name: is_free_desc
methods.description: Checks if a descriptor is invalid/free.

methods.name: is_table_desc
methods.description: Checks if a descriptor is a table descriptor at a given level.

methods.name: is_block_desc
methods.description: Checks if a descriptor is a block descriptor.

methods.name: pte_desc_table
methods.description: Extracts the address of a table from a table descriptor.

methods.name: is_desc_block_aligned
methods.description: Checks if a descriptor is aligned for block mapping at a given level size.

methods.name: is_desc_superset
methods.description: Checks if one descriptor is a superset of another at a given level.

methods.name: debug_show_pte
methods.description: Prints debug information about a page table entry.

methods.name: set_pte_table_desc
methods.description: Sets a page table entry to point to a new subtable.

methods.name: set_pte_block_desc
methods.description: Sets a page table entry to a block or page descriptor.

methods.name: expand_to_table
methods.description: Expands a block descriptor into a subtable.

methods.name: set_mapping
methods.description: Sets up memory mappings in page tables for a given virtual address range.

methods.name: add_map
methods.description: Adds a memory mapping with locking.

methods.name: remove_map
methods.description: Removes a memory mapping with locking.

methods.name: invalidate_tlb_all
methods.description: Invalidates all TLB entries.

methods.name: get_region_desc
methods.description: Generates a page table descriptor for a memory region based on attributes.

methods.name: __add_map
methods.description: Internal function to add a memory mapping without locking.

methods.name: add_arm_mmu_flat_range
methods.description: Maps a flat memory range into page tables.

methods.name: add_arm_mmu_region
methods.description: Maps a region into page tables.

methods.name: inv_dcache_after_map_helper
methods.description: Invalidates data cache for a range after mapping, if applicable.

methods.name: setup_page_tables
methods.description: Initializes page tables with default and platform-specific regions.

methods.name: get_tcr
methods.description: Constructs the translation control register value for a given exception level.

methods.name: enable_mmu_el1
methods.description: Enables the MMU at EL1 with configured page tables.

methods.name: z_arm64_mm_init
methods.description: Initializes the MMU for the primary core, setting up page tables and enabling MMU.

methods.name: sync_domains
methods.description: Synchronizes memory domains across all active domains.

methods.name: __arch_mem_map
methods.description: Internal function to map memory regions with specific attributes.

methods.name: arch_mem_map
methods.description: Public API to map memory regions, including cache and permission handling.

methods.name: arch_mem_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps a memory region.

methods.name: arch_page_phys_get
methods.description: Retrieves the physical address corresponding to a virtual address.

methods.name: arch_virt_region_align
methods.description: Calculates the required alignment for a virtual region.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_max_partitions_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of partitions in a memory domain.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_init
methods.description: Initializes a memory domain with page tables.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_partition_add
methods.description: Adds a partition to a memory domain.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_partition_remove
methods.description: Removes a partition from a memory domain.

methods.name: map_thread_stack
methods.description: Maps a thread's stack into its page tables.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_thread_add
methods.description: Adds a thread to a memory domain, mapping its stack.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_thread_remove
methods.description: Removes a thread from its memory domain, unmapping its stack.

methods.name: z_arm64_swap_ptables
methods.description: Switches the current thread's page tables.

methods.name: z_arm64_thread_mem_domains_init
methods.description: Initializes thread memory domain mappings.

methods.name: z_arm64_swap_mem_domains
methods.description: Swaps the current thread's memory domain page tables.
